subject: Chemistry
notes: Same Chemistry logic as XI: board-order spine, CET as the primary exam weight, NDA a light overlay. XII chemistry is full +2 depth, which NDA does NOT test - so the NDA column is essentially empty here (NDA Chemistry stays at basic/general level).
16 board chapters in board order, grouped into 4 branch phases (physical -> inorganic -> organic -> biomolecules/polymers/green).
NCERT-12 (rationalised) dropped Solid State, p-block (Group 16-18), Polymers, and Green Chemistry; Thermodynamics and Ionic Equilibria sit in NCERT-11. These are flagged as NCERT gaps.

CBSE/NCERT cohort note: Chemical Thermodynamics (Unit 4) and Ionic Equilibria (Unit 3) are Class-11 chapters in NCERT (NCERT bundles ionic equilibrium into its Class-11 'Equilibrium' chapter). CBSE students need both by their Class 11 board exam — a year before the State Board teaches them here — so pull them forward for a CBSE cohort. Marked '◆ CBSE: teach in XI'.

guiding_principles.meaning: XII Chemistry is the heart of MHT-CET (Thermodynamics 53, Electrochemistry 52, Kinetics 46, Solid State 40, and the organic chapters). Units follow board order; CET PYQ frequency is the primary weight.

NDA Chemistry tests only basic/general chemistry; none of the XII +2 chapters (Solid State, Electrochemistry, Coordination, +2 organic, etc.) are in NDA. The NDA column reads 'none' throughout, by design.
Physical -> Inorganic -> Organic -> Biomolecules/Polymers/Green, following the board sequence without reordering.

phases.name: Physical Chemistry
phases.blurb: Solid state, solutions, ionic equilibria, thermodynamics, electrochemistry, kinetics - the numerical heart of CET chemistry.

phases.name: Inorganic Chemistry
phases.blurb: p-block (Groups 16-18), d- and f-block transition elements, and coordination compounds.

phases.name: Organic Chemistry
phases.blurb: Halogen derivatives and the oxygen/nitrogen functional families - alcohols/phenols/ethers, carbonyls/acids, amines.

phases.name: Biomolecules, Polymers & Green Chemistry
phases.blurb: Biomolecules, polymer chemistry, and green/nano chemistry.

units.title: Solid State
units.why_here: Crystalline solids, unit cells, packing efficiency, density, defects. High CET weight (Density 40, Unit Cells 32). NCERT-12 dropped Solid State.

units.title: Solutions
units.why_here: Types of solutions, Raoult's law, colligative properties, Van't Hoff factor. High CET weight (Elevation BP 30, Osmotic Pressure 24).

units.title: Ionic Equilibria
units.why_here: Acid-base theories, Ka/Kb, pH, buffers, salt hydrolysis, solubility product. High CET weight (Ksp 30, pH 24). Sits in NCERT-11 Equilibrium.

units.title: Chemical Thermodynamics and Energetics
units.why_here: Thermodynamic laws, internal energy, enthalpy, Hess's law, entropy, Gibbs free energy. Highest single CET subtopic (First Law 53). Maharashtra XII; NCERT-11.

units.title: Electrochemistry
units.why_here: Conductance, molar conductivity, Kohlrausch, galvanic cells, Nernst equation, Faraday's laws. Very high CET (Galvanic/Nernst 52).

units.title: Chemical Kinetics
units.why_here: Rate of reaction, rate law, order, integrated rate laws, Arrhenius, mechanism. Very high CET (First-Order 46, Rate Law 42).

units.title: Elements of Groups 16, 17 and 18
units.why_here: p-block Groups 16-18: chalcogens, halogens, noble gases - trends, oxoacids, interhalogens. NCERT-12 dropped p-block.

units.title: Transition and Inner Transition Elements
units.why_here: d- and f-block: electronic configuration, oxidation states, colour, magnetism, lanthanoids/actinoids. Strong CET (Inner Transition 26).

units.title: Coordination Compounds
units.why_here: Ligands, coordination number, IUPAC nomenclature, bonding theories (VBT/CFT), isomerism. Strong CET (Ligands 33).

units.title: Halogen Derivatives
units.why_here: Alkyl/aryl halides: classification, preparation, SN1/SN2, elimination, polyhalogens. Strong CET (Classification 26).

units.title: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
units.why_here: Alcohols, phenols, ethers: nomenclature, preparation, properties, reactions, acidity. Top organic CET (IUPAC 36, Phenols 27).

units.title: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids
units.why_here: Aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids: preparation, nucleophilic addition, oxidation/reduction, identification tests. Strong CET (Preparation 31).

units.title: Amines
units.why_here: Amines: classification, preparation, basicity, reactions, diazonium salts. Strong CET (Reactions/Basicity 30).

units.title: Biomolecules
units.why_here: Carbohydrates, amino acids/proteins, nucleic acids, lipids, enzymes. Strong CET (Amino Acids 27, Carbohydrates 22).

units.title: Introduction to Polymer Chemistry
units.why_here: Classification of polymers, monomers, polymerization, important polymers. Strong CET (Monomers 28). NCERT-12 dropped Polymers.

units.title: Green Chemistry and Nanochemistry
units.why_here: Green chemistry principles, atom economy, nanochemistry, nanomaterials. CET-tested (Green 20, Nano 14). Not in NCERT.
